verdict.rationale: Zulip documents self-hosting directly: an installer for a server of your choice, the same software as Zulip Cloud, no paywalled enterprise auth features, and export/import between Cloud and your own servers. Community users confirm it is 100% FOSS and run self-hosted instances. Install-friction complaints are limitations, not contradictions, of a working self-host path. missing for 10: broad distro/packaging support (community reports Debian/Ubuntu-only installs needing a dedicated server or VM), mature containerized deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: When you self-host Zulip, you get the same software as our Zulip Cloud customers.
install a self-hosted Zulip server on a system of your choice
Then, run the installer, providing your email address and the public hostname that users will be able to access your server with
You can move freely between Zulip Cloud hosting and your own servers with our high quality export and import tools.
Zulip is my favorite modern chat program because it's actually 100% FOSS, unlike Mattermost and RocketChat, which are only 'open core'.
